purpose: Fast canonical recall/comparison layer for R9 REAL, R9 SYNTH and quarantined overfit/oracle evidence. Heavy evidence is opened only when a requested comparison cannot be answered from this index or existing event/day indexes.

retrieval_policy.L0: Use this compact index for benchmark economics, roles, core forensic deltas and gap-closure calculations.
retrieval_policy.L1: Use existing R9 REAL/SYNTH event/day indexes for targeted lifecycle/event/date selection.
retrieval_policy.L2: Load only the exact daily or monthly tick partitions needed for chronology/path forensics.
retrieval_policy.L3: Open original MT5 reports or reconstructed full ticklogger archives only for audit/reproduction questions not satisfied by L0-L2.

R9_REAL.authority_role: execution-failure benchmark; broker-native Every Tick Based on Real Ticks evidence
R9_REAL.data_state: validated daily tick-only package; indexed; Drive-audited; do not rebuild
R9_REAL.research_use: execution/path/lifecycle comparison and final broker-native certification reference

R9_SYNTH.authority_role: teacher/north-star reference only; never execution truth
R9_SYNTH.data_state: validated 149-day tick-only package; event/day indexed; Drive-audited; do not rebuild

R9_OVERFIT_ORACLE.teacher_preentry_features: REAL-causal only, 250ms..30s lookbacks; SYNTH future outcomes labels only
R9_OVERFIT_ORACLE.rule: Never use future outcomes, teacher scores, oracle direction or same-sample memorization as execution inputs.

core_forensics.diagnosis: Outer opportunity/regime structure transfers; post-entry ordering, persistence and lifecycle diverge sharply.
